note: Chapter I illustrated, shot-sized: establishing for each place, wide shots carry the narration, close-ups sparing. Recipe of 18 Nov: gemini-2.5-flash-image, face refs only, no plate ref.
style: An oil painting of France in 1625, in the manner of Meissonier and Maurice Leloir, painted alla prima: visible loose brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin transparent glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges away from the faces, broken colour, canvas weave showing through; a single source of light, much of the picture in deep shadow (in daylight scenes: brilliant raking sun and crisp shadow instead); ordinary, unidealised faces, not glamorous, painted in a few planes; a candid, unposed moment, figures off-centre. Exact costume of 1625: doublets, falling lace collars, wide-brimmed plumed felt hats, bucket-top boots, rapiers on baldrics; no tricorns, no wigs. Honey-coloured stone, dark timber and ochre dust by day; candle-gold against blue Paris dusk by night. Not an illustration, not digital art. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

people.dartagnan: D'Artagnan, a Gascon youth of eighteen: a long brown face, high cheekbones, open intelligent eyes, a finely chiselled hooked nose, dark hair to the shoulders, the faint first down of a moustache and no beard; a faded blue woollen doublet, a Béarnais cap with a feather, a long rapier on a leather baldric
people.rochefort: the man of Meung (the Comte de Rochefort): a gentleman of forty to forty-five, black piercing eyes, a pale complexion, a strongly marked nose, a black well-shaped moustache, a small pale scar on the temple; a violet doublet with lace collar
people.milady: Milady de Winter, a woman of twenty-two: pale and fair, long blonde curls falling over her shoulders, large languishing blue eyes, rosy lips, alabaster hands; a dark travelling gown with a lace collar
people.father: D'Artagnan's father, an old Gascon gentleman of about sixty, lean and weathered, grey moustache and tuft, a worn but proud old-fashioned doublet
people.mother: D'Artagnan's mother, a Gascon lady of about fifty in a dark gown and white coif
people.host: the host of the Jolly Miller, a stout cunning innkeeper of fifty in a leather apron, cap in hand

beats.text: Shot: wide. A vociferous curious crowd gathered before the gate of the Jolly Miller inn, craning to see something in the street. No sign, board or lettering anywhere on the building.
Shot: medium. A young Gascon of eighteen riding into town on a small yellow pony, his long sword trailing, a feathered Béarnais cap, a faded blue doublet, looking proudly about him.
Shot: close. Close portrait of the young Gascon: long brown face, high cheekbones, keen intelligent eyes, hooked nose, a proud defiant air.
Shot: medium. The young Gascon struck down in the dust of the inn yard, his sword broken in two beside him, a little blood on his forehead, almost fainting.
Shot: medium. The young Gascon in a fury, hand on his broken sword hilt, threatening the cowering host in the inn kitchen.
Shot: establishing, far. The gate of Saint-Antoine at Paris in 1625, the towers of the Bastille beside it, carts and travellers; a young man selling his yellow pony to a horse dealer.
Shot: wide. The Rue des Fossoyeurs near the Luxembourg: a narrow Paris street of tall old houses; the young Gascon on foot, his little packet under his arm, looking up at a garret window.
beats.at: This chamber was a sort of garret
